title: Conjecture that iterative graph normalization always converges
statement: Let $G$ be a node-weighted graph, and let iterative graph normalization (IGN) denote the iteration of graph normalization, with a non-linear activation applied after each normalization. **Iterative graph normalization convergence conjecture.** Iterative graph normalization always converges. The paper proves convergence for complete graphs and studies local attractivity of maximal independent sets, but general convergence remains unproved.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.07764

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2020).
source_name: Laurent Guigues, “Concerning Iterative Graph Normalization and Maximum Weight Independent Sets”, arXiv:2012.07764 (2020).
